documents.title: Corrigendum To The Notice Of First Extra Ordinary General Meeting Of Financial Year 2026-27.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Intimation Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI Listing Regulations.

analysis.summary: Onemi Technology Solutions Limited (Kissht) reported a strong Q1 FY27 performance with AUM reaching INR 8,001 crores, up 61% year-on-year, and PAT growing 59% year-on-year to INR 95 crores. Management highlighted robust digital lending growth driven by advanced in-house AI and machine learning underwriting models while maintaining a cautious stance on industry-wide asset quality pockets. The company successfully completed its IPO in May 2026, significantly strengthening its net worth to INR 2,245 crores and expanding its NBFC capital adequacy to 40.2%. Furthermore, the company remains firmly on track to meet its full-year guidance on AUM growth, credit costs, gross NPA, and profitability parameters. Onemi Technology Solutions Limited reported its Q1 FY2027 performance, highlighted by AUM crossing ₹8,000 crore and the successful completion of its listing on the NSE and BSE in May 2026.

guidance.claim: Management remains firmly confident of over-delivering on the overall AUM growth guidance of upwards of 40% for the next 12 months.
guidance.quote: So the point I was making on guidance is we remain firmly confident of over-delivering on the number that we had given last quarter of 40%.

guidance.claim: The company firmly holds to its guidance of a 15% reduction in credit cost.
guidance.quote: We firmly hold to our guidance which we gave last quarter, which is 15% reduction in credit cost, and we are tracking well on that.

guidance.claim: Management remains firmly on track for the FY27 guidance set across AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability parameters including ROE and ROA.
guidance.quote: On the guidance for future, we remain firmly on track for the FY27 guidance we set out on different parameters, be it AUM, Gross NPA, credit cost, and profitability including ROE and ROA.

guidance.claim: The company guides for the cost of borrowing to drop by 100 basis points particularly in H2 of FY27.
guidance.quote: So our guidance for FY, particularly H2 of FY27, that you will see the cost of borrowing dropping by 100 basis points and it will only increase as we, as the old debt basically runs off the book, right?

guidance.claim: The company expects AUM growth of north of 40% with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection in FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow at north of 40% in AUM, with disciplined asset quality and calibrated risk selection, while secured business scale-up is also expected to be strong.

guidance.claim: Management targets gross NPA below 2.25% for FY27.
guidance.quote: On asset quality, we are targeting gross NPA below 2.25%, year-on-year reduction in impairment costs of 10%-15%, and continued improvement in Stage-1 mix.

guidance.claim: The company targets a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5% to 5% for FY27.
guidance.quote: On profitability, we are targeting a return on average AUM in the range of 4.5%-5%, which entails a return on average equity in the range of 19-21%.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry-wide bureau data shows headline asset quality looks benign, but stress is building in small-ticket loans and among borrowers carrying debt across multiple lenders.
demand_outlook.quote: The bureau data for the industry now shows a clear divergence beneath a calm surface. Talking about industry, headline asset quality looks benign, yet beneath the surface, stress is building, concentrated in a few places, particularly in the small ticket loans or instances of borrowers carrying debt across several lenders at once, and households taking new lines only to service old ones.

demand_outlook.claim: For the industry, the quality of new customers has softened even as headline delinquencies in personal loans have improved.
demand_outlook.quote: For the industry, the quality of new customers has softened even as headline delinquencies in personal loans have improved - both are true at once.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that economic headwinds such as higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, and currency volatility are weighing on India.
demand_outlook.quote: The global environment has been one of the defining themes of the recent past - higher oil prices, elevated rates, geopolitical disruptions, currency volatility, these are all the factors weighing on India too.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about India's long-term structural credit opportunity while staying realistic about near-term conditions.
demand_outlook.quote: As we look ahead to FY27, we remain optimistic about India's long-term structural credit opportunity. Many reasons for that, not only economic growth that the country will see, but also the huge degree of credit under penetration which exists, while at the same time being realistic and cautious about near-term conditions.

capex_expansion.claim: The Loan Against Property (LAP) business AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states.
capex_expansion.quote: LAP business which we started two years back, the AUM stands at INR 617 crores across 101 branches in eight states, about 7.7% of the total AUM.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration to build capabilities in mutual fund distribution.
capex_expansion.quote: Our subsidiary has secured an AMFI registration already.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add at least 80 more branches for the LAP business by the end of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to have at least 80 more branches by end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Credit cost was 6.80% of average AUM, down from 7.02% in Q4 FY26 and 8.85% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Operating expenses as a proportion of AUM decreased from 19.9% to 18.0%.
margins_costs.quote: You must have seen the operating leverage some evidence of that, 19.9% cost which was opex as a proportion of AUM has already come down to 18.0% percent.

margins_costs.claim: Total income reached Rs 2,209 crore, up 63% year-on-year for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: For FY26, total income reached ₹ 2,209 crore, up 63% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Impairment cost as a percentage of average AUM fell from 9.7% in FY25 to 8.2% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: But the payoff is visible - our impairment cost as a percentage of average AUM has fallen from 9.7% in FY25 to 8.2% in FY26 and in Q4 alone, it stood at 7%.

orders_capacity.claim: Registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million, and customers served increased by 26% year-on-year to 12.25 million.
orders_capacity.quote: The registered users grew 33% year-on-year to 74.6 million. We have now served 12.25 million customers, an increase of 26% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Disbursements for the quarter were INR 3,812 crores, up 37% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Disbursement for the quarter were INR 3,812 crores, up 37% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The funding mix stands at a 46:54 split between on-book AUM of INR 3,716 crores and off-book AUM of INR 4,284 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: On-book AUM of INR 3,716 crores and off-book AUM of INR 4,284 crores, a 46:54 split, supported by more than 45 lending partners.

orders_capacity.claim: Collection efficiency for the quarter stood at 96.82%.
orders_capacity.quote: Net NPA at 0.36% and collection efficiency at 96.82%, which shows our resilience to risk management.

orders_capacity.claim: Loan Against Property (LAP) AUM stands at nearly Rs 518 crore across 98 branches in 8 states.
orders_capacity.quote: LAP AUM stands at nearly ₹ 518 crore, across 98 branches in 8 states, contributing 7.3% of total AUM.

orders_capacity.claim: Off-book AUM stands at Rs 3,510 crore with FLDG provided up to 5%.
orders_capacity.quote: Off-book AUM stands at ₹ 3,510 crore, where we provide FLDG up to 5%, which is the First Loss Default Guarantee.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital adequacy in the NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter following the IPO.
capital_allocation.quote: Capital adequacy in our NBFC subsidiary rose to 40.2% from 25.3% last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023, supported by retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth grew to INR 2,245 crores, nearly four times its level in March 2023, built on retained earnings, organic profitability, and the IPO completed in May 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth of the NBFC subsidiary has grown to Rs 1,343 crore, reflecting a 2.4x increase over 3 years.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth has grown to ₹ 1,343 crore - 2.4x increase over 3 years, almost entirely through retained earnings and organic profitability.

capital_allocation.claim: Approximately Rs 630 crore (75% of the primary issue) has been infused as fresh equity into the NBFC subsidiary Si Creva Capital.
capital_allocation.quote: 75% of the primary issue, approximately ₹ 630 crore have been already infused as fresh equity into our NBFC subsidiary, which is Si Creva Capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted two macroeconomic developments to watch: West Asia risks transmitting through higher oil prices, shipping costs, and customer confidence, and the Reserve Bank's push on FCNR(B) deposits easing system liquidity.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first is West Asia, where the risk is not geography but transmission through higher oil prices, the cost of shipping, and, over time, the confidence of the customer. The second is the Reserve Bank's push on FCNR(B) deposits, which has drawn in foreign currency and eased system liquidity.

risks_headwinds.claim: Out of caution based on early warning signals, the company paused lending across roughly 450 pin codes last quarter, of which approximately 40% have now been reopened.
risks_headwinds.quote: Just to give you an instance, last quarter, out of caution, we paused lending across roughly 450 pin codes based on what our early warning system had flagged. We have re-examined those pin codes since. The signals have turned modestly positive, and we have reopened approximately 40% of these pin codes already.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management reduced disbursements by approximately 7% and paused lending across approximately 450 pin codes due to elevated risks flagged by early-warning systems.
risks_headwinds.quote: As a measure of prudence, we reduced disbursements by approximately 7% and paused lending across approximately 450 pin codes, where early-warning systems flagged elevated risks - while continuing to grow in high-quality segments.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates that the cost of borrowing will drop by 100 basis points in H2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So our guidance for FY, particularly H2 of FY27, that you will see the cost of borrowing dropping by 100 basis points and it will only increase as we, as the old debt basically runs off the book, right?

management_commitments.claim: The LAP business will achieve breakeven around Q3 of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Till now last year this quarter and around Q3 or so LAP will achieve breakeven.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to get another credit rating upgrade from rating agencies at some point in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are cautiously optimistic on getting another upgrade from both of these institutions at some point in FY27, but that is an active discussion that will happen with the course of next 6 to 8 months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
